message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Create Binaries

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  goreleaser:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: jdx/mise-action@v4
        with:
          install: true
          cache: false

      - run: task frontend:install
      - run: task frontend:build

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version-file: "go.mod"

      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-go-

      - name: Get dependencies
        run: go mod download

      - name: Run templ generate
        run: go tool templ generate

      - name: Extract version from tag
        id: extract_version
        run: |
          VERSION=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}
          VERSION=${VERSION#v}
          echo "VERSION=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Run GoReleaser
        uses: goreleaser/goreleaser-action@v6
        with:
          distribution: goreleaser
          version: "~> v2"
          args: release --clean
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GORELEASER }}
          VERSION: ${{ env.VERSION }}",
  "rationale": "The workflow repeatedly fetches Go dependencies via `go mod download` on every release/dispatch run, and the repository pins go.mod/go.sum, so a dependency cache is applicable under P-LIT-GHA-CACHE. No equivalent cache exists in the job (mise cache is disabled and unrelated to Go modules). Adding actions/cache@v4 for ~/go/pkg/mod keyed on go.mod/go.sum preserves all build/test steps and required checks, adds no secrets, privileged actions, publishing, or new network access beyond the existing module downloads, and matches the evidenced Go module cache pattern.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9"]
}
